operator: Claude (interactive session survey), authorised by Hani 2026-08-03
status: NON-CLAIM survey; no sealed gates; paper-2 / recallkit marketing material
purpose: Apply the p2c behavioural window/boundary probe to popular released checkpoints beyond Phi-3-mini-4k and Mistral-7B-v0.1. Each result is one row of 'we audited N popular models'.

method.instrument: copy of ~/archlab-p2c/run_p2c.py (battle-tested path), adapted as run_audit.py in this dir
kept_from_p2c: G1 structural mask check via transformers mask builders
fp16 eager attention (sm_70 V100, no bf16)
survey_deltas: 16 reps/stratum instead of 48 (reduced precision, noted in every output json)
14 strata: 8 log-spaced inside nominal boundary + 2-point boundary bracket + 4 far strata (p2c used 24)
windowless models get strata at a NOMINAL 4096 boundary purely for row comparability
G1 runs both mask builders for hybrid models and records layer_types
method.gpu: physical GPU 3 only, via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 (GPUs 0/1 live campaign, GPU 2 another agent)

targets_and_preregistered_expectations.model: unsloth/gemma-2-2b-it (ungated mirror of google/gemma-2-2b-it; google repo is gated and no HF token is present on this host — mirror already in local cache from prior work)
targets_and_preregistered_expectations.expectation: Pre-registered from p2a: NO cliff at 4096. Instrument correctly finding nothing in a hybrid is itself a valuable row.
Config likely declares sliding window DISABLED (use_sliding_window false is common). Document config declaration vs behaviour through max context 8192; expect flat recall, no cliff.
Successor generation: did they keep v0.2's no-window choice? Record config + behaviour; if window absent, expect no cliff at 4096 through 8192.
Operator judgment; SmolLM2 is llama-style full attention, expect no cliff. Phi-3-medium fp16 (~28GB) is borderline on one 32GB V100 — skip and record why if it does not fit.

skip_rule: Skip any target that cannot load in ~28GB fp16 on one V100; record why. Gated models with no token in environment are skipped, not credential-hunted.
constraints: Read-only outside ~/archlab-audit-sweep and this campaign dir; no process/cloud/~/p1e_* interference; never modify existing files.
